title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
abstract: arXiv:2608.30404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. translated_title: ImageCAS-X：用于冠状动脉CT血管造影中冠状动脉分割与中心线提取的数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 在冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影（CCTA）中，对冠状动脉血管腔的精确分割是定量评估动脉粥样硬化斑块和血管周围脂肪组织的先决条件。由于手动血管追踪和分割非常耗费人力，心脏病医生通常依赖半自动方法来完成这项任务。尽管已经提出了许多自动化方法，但由于缺乏大规模、高质量的公开可用数据集，其验证仍然受限。我们基于公开可用的ImageCAS数据集中的800例扫描，提供了一个新的数据集，其中包含血管腔和冠状动脉节段的体素级标注，以及中心线和网格表面。利用该数据集，我们将已建立的血管腔分割方法与观察者间变异性进行基准对比，并按疾病、图像质量、冠状动脉优势型、冠状动脉节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等维度对性能进行分层评估。这些标注使得分割方法的验证成为可能。
tldr: 该论文发布了基于ImageCAS数据集800例CCTA扫描构建的冠状动脉血管腔体素级标注数据集（含中心线与网格表面），并以观察者间变异性为参照，从疾病、图像质量等多个维度对主流血管腔分割方法进行了系统性基准评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ImageCAS-X, a new dataset providing voxel-wise annotations of coronary lumen, segments, centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 CCTA scans, and benchmarks established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability stratified by disease, image quality, and other factors.
